cases.script: set -e; false | tee out.log; echo REACHED
set -eo pipefail; false | tee out.log; echo REACHED
set -e; sh -c 'echo "fetch failed: 403" >&2; exit 1' 2>&1 | tee update.log; echo RELOADING
set -eo pipefail; sh -c 'echo "fetch failed: 403" >&2; exit 1' 2>&1 | tee update.log; echo RELOADING
gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase-file pass.txt --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 seeds.txt > backup.gpg

gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase-file pass.txt --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 seeds.txt > backup.gpg; gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase-file pass.txt --decrypt backup.gpg > restored.txt; status=$?; cmp -s seeds.txt restored.txt && echo RESTORED; exit $status
cases.stderr:
gpg: keybox '/tmp/gpg-redirect-roundtrip-t0lacgim/.gnupg/pubring.kbx' created
gpg: decrypt_message failed: Unknown system error

cases.script: gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase-file pass.txt --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 --output backup.gpg seeds.txt

gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase-file pass.txt --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 --output backup.gpg seeds.txt && gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase-file pass.txt --decrypt --output restored.txt backup.gpg && cmp -s seeds.txt restored.txt && echo RESTORED
cases.stderr:
